stars.note: More minutes with Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren out: he played 38.0 minutes a game in the 1 game without them this season.
stars.why: Oklahoma City is still without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Aday Mara and Jaylin Williams, so the offense runs almost entirely through him; he has played 36 to 38 minutes in his last three games. Alex Caruso is back from a hip impingement tonight, which adds a guard but not a scorer.

Towns is questionable with knee inflammation after scoring 30 in 29 minutes on Sunday. OG Anunoby is out and Josh Hart is also questionable, so if Towns plays he is the clear second option next to Jalen Brunson; if he sits, Andre Drummond started at center the last time Towns missed a game.

Brunson is the one healthy constant for New York with OG Anunoby and Jordan Clarkson out and Towns, Josh Hart and Miles McBride all questionable. He played 36 minutes on November 21, the last game Towns missed.

stars.note: More center minutes with Ryan Kalkbrenner out: the team has played 53 center minutes a game lately. More minutes with Dennis Schroder out: he played 34.0 minutes a game in the 7 games without him this season.
stars.why: Reid has played 42, 39 and 38 minutes in his last three games because Charlotte is without Ryan Kalkbrenner at center and Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder on the wing. All three are out or doubtful again tonight against Chicago.

Jerome has started both games since returning from a hip injury and played 29 minutes on Monday with Cameron Boozer out. Boozer, Jerami Grant, Scotty Pippen Jr. and GG Jackson are all out again tonight, so the Memphis offense still leans on him.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 25.5 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Hendricks has played 27 and 24 minutes off the bench in the two games without Cameron Boozer, but he scored only eight points total in those games. Boozer and Jerami Grant are out again, so the minutes should be there.

scrubs.note: More minutes with OG Anunoby out: he played 21.0 minutes a game in the 2 games without him this season.
scrubs.why: Drummond started at center and played 23 minutes when Karl-Anthony Towns missed November 21, then played 19 minutes off the bench on Sunday with OG Anunoby out. Towns is questionable tonight, which is what decides Drummond's role.

Wolf has started Brooklyn's last two games over Egor Demin and played 25 to 26 minutes in both. Nolan Traore is out with a hamstring strain, which keeps the starting group the same. His game has a 232.5-point total.

Stirtz played 32 minutes when Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sat on November 22 and 19 minutes when he returned on Monday. Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and Aday Mara are still out, but Alex Caruso's return tonight could take some of his guard minutes.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 21.0 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Stewart has played 21 minutes off the bench in both games without Cameron Boozer. He is a backup big, so Boozer's absence has not changed his role much.

Williams is off the injury report after missing two games for planned hamstring management. He started and played 30 minutes on November 17, and Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder are still out, so Charlotte has wing minutes for him.

scrubs.note: More minutes with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: he played 21.0 minutes a game in the 2 games without them this season.
scrubs.why: Prosper has played 19 to 24 minutes off the bench in Memphis's last three games, with Jerami Grant and Cameron Boozer out. Both are out again tonight.
Wells has started every recent game for Memphis but his minutes fell to 20 on Monday. Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant and Scotty Pippen Jr. are all out again.

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
